subject: Your Refill Is Ready
body: Hi, just letting you know your refill submitted this morning is ready for pickup at Kroger Health Pharmacy whenever it's convenient for you. Our pharmacy hours are 9 AM to 8 PM today. Thanks, Kroger Health Pharmacy

subject: Auto-Refill Processed and Ready
body: Your scheduled auto-refill has been processed and is ready for pickup. No action is needed on your part, just stop by whenever works for you this week. Thank you, Costco Pharmacy Network

subject: New Prescription Received - Ready for Pickup
body: We received a new prescription from Dr. Alvarez this afternoon and it's already filled and ready. You can pick it up any time before we close at 9 PM. Take care, Sunrise Family Pharmacy

subject: Early Fill Approved by Your Provider
body: Your provider approved an early fill of your medication ahead of your upcoming trip, and it's ready for pickup now. Safe travels! Greenfield Clinic Pharmacy

subject: Curbside Pickup Available for Your Order
body: Your order is ready and curbside pickup is available if you'd rather not come inside, just call the number on your receipt when you arrive and we'll bring it out. Thanks, Meijer Pharmacy

subject: Delivery Scheduled for Tomorrow
body: Your prescription delivery is scheduled to arrive tomorrow between 10 AM and 2 PM. No signature is required, but feel free to reach out if you have any questions before then. HealthPartners Mail Order Pharmacy

subject: Your Medications Have Been Synced for Pickup Together
body: As part of our medication sync program, we've aligned your refills so they're all ready together this month instead of on separate days. Everything is ready now at the pharmacy counter. Central Valley Pharmacy Group

subject: Insurance Confirmed - Low Copay This Month
body: Good news, your insurance came back with a lower copay than usual on this fill. Your prescription is ready for pickup at the reduced price. Thanks, BlueCross Pharmacy Benefits

subject: Your Compounded Medication Is Ready
body: The compounded medication your provider ordered has finished preparation and is ready for pickup. As always, feel free to ask our pharmacist any questions when you arrive. Lakeside Compounding Pharmacy

subject: Flu Shot and Refill Ready for Your Visit
body: Just a note that both your flu shot appointment and your regular refill are set for this Thursday. No prep needed on your end, we'll take care of both when you arrive. Walgreens Community Pharmacy

subject: Refill Request Received - Ready by End of Day
body: We got your refill request through the app this morning and it will be ready for pickup by end of day. Thanks for using our online refill service. Rite Aid Pharmacy Team

subject: Prior Authorization Approved - Rx Now Ready
body: Your provider's prior authorization request was approved by your insurance and your medication is now ready for pickup at the original copay. OptumRx Specialty Pharmacy

subject: Switched to Generic - Ready and More Affordable
body: With your provider's approval, we switched your prescription to the generic equivalent, which brings your cost down significantly. It's ready for pickup whenever you're free. Prime Therapeutics

subject: You're Enrolled in Auto-Refill
body: This confirms you're now enrolled in automatic refills for your maintenance medication. We'll notify you each time an order is on its way, no further action needed from you. Express Scripts Home Delivery

subject: Upcoming Auto-Refill in 3 Days
body: Just a heads up that your next automatic refill is scheduled to process in 3 days. If everything looks right on your end, there's nothing you need to do. PharmaCare Direct

subject: Pharmacist Available for Questions at Pickup
body: Your prescription is ready, and our pharmacist is available if you'd like to go over dosing or possible side effects when you come in. No appointment needed. Northgate Drug Store

subject: Drive-Thru Open Late This Week
body: A reminder that our drive-thru is open until 9 PM this week if you'd rather not come inside. Your prescription is ready whenever you'd like to swing by. UPMC Pharmacy Services

subject: Your 90-Day Supply Is Ready
body: Your 90-day supply has been filled and is ready for pickup. This should carry you through the next quarter without needing another refill in the meantime. Humana Pharmacy Solutions

subject: Mail Order Shipped - Tracking Included
body: Your mail order prescription shipped this morning. Here's the tracking number for your reference: 1Z999AA10123456784. Expected arrival is within 3 to 5 business days. HealthPartners Mail Order Pharmacy

subject: Second Half of Your Order Now Ready
body: The remainder of your prescription that was on backorder has arrived and is now ready for pickup along with the rest of your order. Sorry for the split delivery. Walmart Pharmacy Rx

subject: Welcome - Your First Prescription Is Ready
body: Welcome to Piedmont Health Pharmacy! Your first prescription with us is ready for pickup, and our team is happy to answer any questions as you get settled in with a new pharmacy.

subject: Refill Denied by Insurance - Contact Your Provider
body: Unfortunately your insurance denied coverage for this refill request. We recommend reaching out to your provider's office to discuss alternatives, we're happy to help facilitate that conversation. Mercy Medical Center Pharmacy

subject: Card on File Will Be Charged at Pickup
body: Just a heads up that the payment card on file will be charged $12.50 for your copay when you pick up your prescription today. Let us know if you'd like to use a different card. CVS Health Pharmacy Services

subject: You're All Set for Text Notifications
body: Thanks for opting in, you'll now receive text updates when your prescriptions are ready. You can manage or turn off these notifications any time from your account settings. Kaiser Permanente Pharmacy Services

subject: Refill Called In by Your Doctor's Office
body: Your doctor's office called in an approval for your refill this morning, and it's already filled and waiting for you at the counter. Riverside Hospital Pharmacy

subject: Last Day to Pick Up Before Return to Stock
body: Just a friendly reminder that tomorrow is the last day to pick up your ready prescription before it's returned to stock per pharmacy policy. Let us know if you need us to hold it longer. Good Neighbor Pharmacy

subject: Flu Shot Season Bundle Ready
body: We noticed you're due for both a flu shot and a refill this month, so we've bundled them together for a single easy visit. Everything is ready whenever you'd like to stop in. Publix Pharmacy Services

subject: This Week's Pharmacy Digest
body: Here's what's new this week: extended weekend hours starting Saturday, a reminder about our medication sync program, and your current refill status showing ready for pickup. Kroger Health Pharmacy

subject: New Pharmacy Hours Starting Next Month
body: Starting next month our hours will shift slightly to 8 AM to 7 PM on weekdays. In the meantime, your current prescription is ready under our regular hours. Sunrise Family Pharmacy

subject: Holiday Hours and Your Prescription Status
body: We'll have modified hours this coming holiday weekend, details are on our website. Your prescription is ready now if you'd like to pick it up before the holiday. Meijer Pharmacy

subject: Rx Transferred Back to Local Pharmacy
body: As requested, we transferred your prescription from mail order back to our local pharmacy and it's ready for pickup here whenever you're ready. Central Valley Pharmacy Group

subject: Family Prescriptions Ready Together
body: All three prescriptions for your household are ready together this week, so you can pick everything up in one trip if that's easier. Piedmont Health Pharmacy

subject: Discount Card Applied Successfully
body: Good news, the discount card you added to your profile was applied successfully and brought your cost down on this fill. Your prescription is ready for pickup. Good Neighbor Pharmacy

subject: Provider Approved Your Refill via Portal
body: Your provider approved your refill request through the patient portal this morning, and it's already filled and waiting for you. OptumRx Specialty Pharmacy

subject: Auto-Refill Paused as Requested
body: This confirms we've paused automatic refills on your account as you requested. Just reach out whenever you'd like to resume, no rush on our end. Express Scripts Home Delivery

subject: New Medication Ready - Counseling Recommended
body: Since this is a new medication for you, we'd recommend a quick chat with our pharmacist at pickup to go over how to take it, but it's entirely optional. It's ready now. Lakeside Compounding Pharmacy

subject: Your Trial Supply Is Ready
body: Your provider ordered a 30-day trial supply to start, which is ready for pickup now. We can discuss a longer-term refill once you've had a chance to try it. Mercy Medical Center Pharmacy

subject: Refrigerated Medication Ready - Please Pick Up Soon
body: Your medication requires refrigeration, so we'd appreciate it if you could pick it up within the next day or two to make sure it stays at the right temperature. Harborview Medical Pharmacy

subject: Insurance Plan Change Processed
body: We've updated your account to reflect your new insurance plan, and your prescription is ready for pickup at the adjusted rate under your new coverage. BlueCross Pharmacy Benefits

subject: Weekend Hours Reminder
body: Just a reminder that we're open Saturday from 9 AM to 5 PM this weekend if you'd like to pick up your ready prescription then instead of during the week. Northgate Drug Store

subject: Your Prescription Is Ready a Day Early
body: Good news, your prescription finished processing a day ahead of schedule and is ready for pickup now if you'd like to grab it early. Walgreens Community Pharmacy

subject: Specialty Medication Ready for Pickup
body: Your specialty medication has arrived and completed our quality check, it's ready for pickup at the specialty counter. Please bring your ID as usual. UPMC Pharmacy Services

subject: Text From Your Pharmacy: Rx Ready
body: Rx ready for pickup at Rite Aid, Main St location. Open until 9pm today. Reply here or call the pharmacy with any questions. Rite Aid Pharmacy Team

subject: Reminder: Refill Available Anytime This Month
body: This is just a routine reminder that your monthly refill is available to pick up any time that works for your schedule this month, no deadline pressure on our end. PharmaCare Direct

subject: Prescription Ready After Pharmacist Review
body: Our pharmacist reviewed your new prescription alongside your other medications and everything looks good, it's ready for pickup now. Central Valley Pharmacy Group

subject: Your Order Is Packed and Ready to Ship
body: Your mail order prescription is packed and will ship out today, you should receive tracking information within the next few hours. Thanks for your patience. HealthPartners Mail Order Pharmacy

subject: Two Prescriptions Ready, One Still Processing
body: Two of your three prescriptions are ready for pickup now, the third is still being verified with your insurance and we'll follow up once it's ready too. Humana Pharmacy Solutions
